FN-6YYLC11-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 338
Committee: Boards, Agencies and Sponsor: Representative Parker Moore
Commissions
Analyst: Hunter Lapp Date: 03/03/2025
House Bill 338 as introduced would reduce receipts to the Alabama Electronic Security Board
of Licensure Fund by a board-estimated $2,500 annually by exempting certain activities from
regulation of the board.
Page 1
